about: cc-capsule-identity lab falsifiers (tasks 001 and 005). Each one plants a bug in the lab CID harness (src/lib.rs), a fixture manifest, or the wc-001 test driver, and requires every named test to FAIL for its own reason, never from a build error. command is "capsule-identity" and file paths are relative to examples/agent-host/, so a lane file is ../../lab/capsule-identity/... . The canonical runner falsify.py has no "capsule-identity" command yet (provider BACKLOG item 8c; Flint routes it), so each is proved by hand until it lands: break, run the named tests with `cargo test --locked` in this lane, see each fail, revert byte for byte.
